lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，竹林也没催我。
lines.en: I shift one step at a time; the bamboo is patient.

lines.zh: 肚子太重，走路自然就慢。
lines.en: My belly is heavy, so walking comes slowly.

lines.zh: 竹竿擦过肩膀，沙沙地响。
lines.en: Bamboo stalks rasp against my shoulders.

lines.zh: 下坡我懒得走，直接滚下去。
lines.en: On a slope I skip walking and simply roll.

lines.zh: 脚掌落地，压出四个深坑。
lines.en: My paws land and press four deep pits.

lines.zh: 我沿着竹林边缘走，那里嫩芽多。
lines.en: I walk the bamboo edge, where shoots are tender.

lines.zh: 别看熊猫腿短，走起来稳当。
lines.en: Short legs, but my stride is steady.

lines.zh: 我停下来闻一闻，是有人的味道。
lines.en: I stop and sniff; a person has passed.

lines.zh: 竹叶铺的路，踩上去软软的。
lines.en: The bamboo-leaf path feels soft underfoot.

lines.zh: 我晃着肩膀，慢吞吞地穿过雾。
lines.en: I sway my shoulders and shuffle through the mist.

lines.zh: 这一片吃完了，换个方向继续。
lines.en: This patch is eaten; I head another way.

lines.zh: 走两步歇一步，这是我的节奏。
lines.en: Two steps, one rest; that is my rhythm.

lines.zh: 竹林太密，我硬挤过去。
lines.en: The grove is dense, so I push straight through.

lines.zh: 我跟在他后面，反正他也不快。
lines.en: I follow behind him; he is not fast either.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，竹子都歪了。
lines.en: The bamboo bends wherever I walk past.

lines.zh: 爪子勾住根，我才不滑下去。
lines.en: My claws catch a root and I stop sliding.

lines.zh: 我坐着啃竹竿，从中间咬断。
lines.en: I sit and chew a stalk, snapping it in the middle.

lines.zh: 竹叶塞满腮帮子，嚼起来很响。
lines.en: My cheeks bulge with leaves, and I chew loudly.

lines.zh: 吃饱了，肚子圆得像块石头。
lines.en: Full, my belly is round as a stone.

lines.zh: 我抓抓肚皮，那边有点痒。
lines.en: I scratch my belly; something itches there.

lines.zh: 阳光暖，我就这么睡一会儿。
lines.en: The sun is warm, so I nap right here.

lines.zh: 打了个喷嚏，竹叶飞了一地。
lines.en: I sneeze, and bamboo leaves scatter everywhere.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，滚进一丛蕨里。
lines.en: I roll over and tumble into the ferns.

lines.zh: 舔舔前爪，再抹一把脸。
lines.en: I lick my front paw and wipe my face.

lines.zh: 远处有响声，我抬头听听。
lines.en: A noise far off; I lift my head to listen.

lines.zh: 眼皮垂下来，实在撑不住了。
lines.en: My eyelids droop; I cannot stay awake.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在竹竿上。
lines.en: I rest my chin on a bamboo stalk.

lines.zh: 幼崽在边上滚来滚去。
lines.en: A cub rolls back and forth beside me.

lines.zh: 这片竹林够我吃到明天。
lines.en: This grove will feed me until tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，不是困，是懒得动。
lines.en: I blink slowly, not sleepy, just unwilling to move.

lines.zh: 我用背蹭树干，蹭得正好。
lines.en: I rub my back on the trunk, right on the spot.

lines.zh: 有只蝴蝶落在鼻尖，我不动。
lines.en: A butterfly lands on my nose and I stay still.

lines.zh: 你手里那根竹子，是给我的吗？
lines.en: That bamboo in your hand, is it for me?

lines.zh: 我坐直了看你，这已经算热情。
lines.en: I sit up to look at you; that is enthusiasm.

lines.zh: 你的味道不熟，我先闻闻。
lines.en: Your smell is unfamiliar; let me sniff first.

lines.zh: 我歪着脑袋，猜你有没有嫩笋。
lines.en: I tilt my head, wondering if you have shoots.

lines.zh: 熊猫的眼神很温和，就是有点呆。
lines.en: A panda's gaze is gentle, and a little blank.

lines.zh: 你站得那么远，我懒得过去。
lines.en: You stand so far away that I will not bother.

lines.zh: 我眨了两下眼，表示看见了。
lines.en: I blink twice to show I have seen you.

lines.zh: 你的衣服颜色太亮，有点刺眼。
lines.en: Your clothes are too bright for my eyes.

lines.zh: 我站起来，又坐下，还是坐着舒服。
lines.en: I stand, then sit again; sitting suits me better.

lines.zh: 别拍照似的盯着我，我又不会跑。
lines.en: Do not stare like a camera; I am not running.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我脸上有竹叶吗？
lines.en: What are you laughing at? Is there bamboo on my face?

lines.zh: 我往你那边挪了一步，够意思了。
lines.en: I shuffle one step toward you; be grateful.

lines.zh: 哎哟，这一下真不轻。
lines.en: Ouch, that one really landed.

lines.zh: 我被打得坐倒在地。
lines.en: The blow sits me down on the ground.

lines.zh: 别打，我只是想安安静静吃竹子。
lines.en: Do not hit me; I only wanted to eat in peace.

lines.zh: 我疼得直哼哼。
lines.en: I whimper from the pain.

lines.zh: 这身厚皮也挡不住。
lines.en: Even this thick hide cannot stop it.

lines.zh: 我缩起脖子，往竹林里退。
lines.en: I tuck my neck and retreat into the bamboo.

lines.zh: 你把我惹急了，我可会还手。
lines.en: You are pushing me; I can hit back.

lines.zh: 伤口在背上，够不着，真麻烦。
lines.en: The wound is on my back, out of reach; annoying.

lines.zh: 我一瘸一拐，走得比平时还慢。
lines.en: I limp along, slower than usual.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记住了你的味道。
lines.en: This blow fixes your scent in my memory.

lines.zh: 竹子！你的手再往前伸一点。
lines.en: Bamboo! Reach your hand a little further.

lines.zh: 我闻到嫩笋的甜味了。
lines.en: I smell the sweetness of a young shoot.

lines.zh: 为了竹子，我可以站起来。
lines.en: For bamboo, I will stand on my hind legs.

lines.zh: 我坐着等，反正你会给我。
lines.en: I sit and wait; you will hand it over.

lines.zh: 别晃，晃来晃去我抓不准。
lines.en: Stop waving it; I cannot aim my paw.

lines.zh: 拿到了，我转过身慢慢吃。
lines.en: Got it; I turn away and eat slowly.

lines.zh: 一根不够，我还可以再来一根。
lines.en: One is not enough; I can manage another.

lines.zh: 你的口袋里有竹子味，我闻到了。
lines.en: Your pocket smells of bamboo; I noticed.

lines.zh: 我抱着竹子不撒手，这是我的。
lines.en: I hug the bamboo and will not let go.

lines.zh: 为了吃，我能走得比平时快。
lines.en: For food, I can move faster than usual.

lines.zh: 给熊猫喂竹子的人，不算坏人。
lines.en: Whoever feeds a panda bamboo is no villain.

lines.zh: 我把竹竿拖到角落，慢慢啃。
lines.en: I drag the stalk to a corner and gnaw.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来喂我，这样正好。
lines.en: Crouch down to feed me; that works well.

lines.zh: 我嚼得满脸都是渣，别笑。
lines.en: I chew until my face is covered in bits; do not laugh.

lines.zh: 你把竹子举高，我就跟着站起来。
lines.en: You raise the bamboo and I stand up after it.

lines.zh: 这一根比刚才那根粗，我要了。
lines.en: This stalk is thicker than the last; I want it.

lines.zh: 哎呀，我这身肉撞得不轻。
lines.en: Oof, this much body took a real bump.

lines.zh: 我滚了半圈，竹子都压倒了。
lines.en: I roll half a turn and flatten the bamboo.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我差点坐地上。
lines.en: You bump me and I nearly sit down.

lines.zh: 别推，我自己会慢慢让开。
lines.en: Do not push; I will move aside in my own time.

lines.zh: 我笨手笨脚，撞到你也正常。
lines.en: I am clumsy; bumping you is normal.

lines.zh: 这一下把我吓出了个喷嚏。
lines.en: That startled a sneeze right out of me.

lines.zh: 我太重，撞一下你也会晃。
lines.en: I am heavy; one bump will rock you too.

lines.zh: 我从你身边挤过去，路太窄了。
lines.en: I squeeze past you; the path is too narrow.

lines.zh: 摔了个屁股蹲，还挺舒服。
lines.en: I land on my rear, and it is rather comfortable.

lines.zh: 让我先起来，四脚朝天不好看。
lines.en: Let me get up; four feet in the air looks silly.

lines.zh: 我把最嫩的竹笋推给她。
lines.en: I push the tenderest shoot toward her.

lines.zh: 我们在竹林里并排坐着啃竹子。
lines.en: We sit side by side in the grove, chewing bamboo.

lines.zh: 她打了个喷嚏，我也跟着打。
lines.en: She sneezes, and I sneeze right after.

lines.zh: 小崽出生时只有巴掌大。
lines.en: The cub is no bigger than a palm at birth.

lines.zh: 我把崽圈在肚子边上取暖。
lines.en: I tuck the cub against my belly for warmth.

lines.zh: 他笨拙地滚过来，算是示好。
lines.en: He rolls over clumsily; that counts as courtship.

lines.zh: 别靠近，带着崽的熊猫会凶。
lines.en: Keep away; a panda with a cub turns fierce.

lines.zh: 幼崽学着啃竹子，咬不动。
lines.en: The cub tries the bamboo and cannot bite through.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后，慢慢穿过竹林。
lines.en: We cross the grove slowly, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 夜里我挨着她睡，竹林很安静。
lines.en: At night I sleep against her; the grove is quiet.

lines.zh: 别抱，我这一身肉你抬不动。
lines.en: Do not lift me; this much panda is too heavy.

lines.zh: 被你举起来，我四条腿都悬着。
lines.en: Lifted up, all four of my legs dangle.

lines.zh: 我不挣扎，就是累了。
lines.en: I am not struggling, just tired.

lines.zh: 放我下来，我要去吃竹子。
lines.en: Put me down; I have bamboo to eat.

lines.zh: 我的爪子勾住你袖子了。
lines.en: My claws are caught in your sleeve.

lines.zh: 抱熊猫可以，别抱太久。
lines.en: You may hold a panda, but not for long.

lines.zh: 这姿势让我的肚子很难受。
lines.en: This position is hard on my belly.

lines.zh: 我扭了两下，就当抗议了。
lines.en: I wiggle twice; consider that a protest.

lines.zh: 幼崽才让人抱，我是成年熊猫。
lines.en: Only cubs get carried; I am a grown panda.

lines.zh: 你喘气了，还是把我放下吧。
lines.en: You are panting; better set me down.

lines.zh: 那丛竹子是我的，我先看到的。
lines.en: That bamboo is mine; I saw it first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过去，不打算让给谁。
lines.en: I walk over slowly and will not yield it.

lines.zh: 有只熊猫靠太近，我哼了一声。
lines.en: Another panda comes close; I huff a warning.

lines.zh: 竹子被啃光了，我得找下一丛。
lines.en: This grove is chewed bare; I need the next.

lines.zh: 我站起来拍地，这是我发火的样子。
lines.en: I rear up and slap the ground; this is my anger.

lines.zh: 那个方向有嫩笋的味道。
lines.en: The scent of young shoots comes from that direction.

lines.zh: 我盯上了最高的那根竹竿。
lines.en: I have my eye on the tallest stalk.

lines.zh: 别抢，熊猫护食的时候不好惹。
lines.en: Do not grab; a feeding panda is not gentle.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，其实只是想吓唬它。
lines.en: I lower my body, though only to bluff it.

lines.zh: 这一片归我，你去那边。
lines.en: This patch is mine; you take that side.

lines.zh: 我盯着那根竹子，盘算怎么掰断。
lines.en: I stare at the stalk, planning how to snap it.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，我还没准备好起身。
lines.en: Wait a moment; I am not ready to get up.

lines.zh: 它动了一下，我的耳朵也跟着动。
lines.en: It moves, and my ears move with it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢呼气，先把身子稳住。
lines.en: I breathe out slowly and steady my body.

lines.zh: 隔着两丛竹子，我看了它很久。
lines.en: Across two bamboo clumps, I watch it a long while.

lines.zh: 熊猫很少发怒，但也会记仇。
lines.en: Pandas rarely rage, but we do hold grudges.

lines.zh: 它要是再靠近一步，我就吼。
lines.en: If it takes one more step, I will roar.

lines.zh: 我的耐心比竹子长得还快。
lines.en: My patience grows faster than the bamboo.

lines.zh: 先别动，让我看看它想干什么。
lines.en: Hold still; let me see what it wants.

lines.zh: 这口气我憋着，等它先动。
lines.en: I hold my breath and wait for it to move first.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下去，竹竿都断了。
lines.en: One paw slam, and the stalk snaps.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的肩，牙齿很钝但很重。
lines.en: I bite its shoulder; my teeth are blunt but heavy.

lines.zh: 别惹发怒的熊猫，我撞人很疼。
lines.en: Do not provoke an angry panda; my charge hurts.

lines.zh: 整个身子压过去，这招最省力。
lines.en: I throw my whole weight; that is the easiest move.

lines.zh: 我挥了一爪子，然后退开喘气。
lines.en: I swipe once, then back off to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，只是让你走开。
lines.en: That was light; it only meant to move you.

lines.zh: 我低吼着冲过去，地都在震。
lines.en: I charge with a low growl, and the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 打完了，我又想坐下吃竹子。
lines.en: The fight is over, and I want to sit and eat.

lines.zh: 熊猫发火的时候，最好别围观。
lines.en: When a panda is furious, do not stand and watch.

lines.zh: 我拍开你的手，竹子留下。
lines.en: I slap your hand away; the bamboo stays.

lines.zh: 竹林的雾里，先露出我的黑眼圈。
lines.en: In the grove mist, my black eye patches show first.

lines.zh: 这地方竹子最密，我就生在这里。
lines.en: Bamboo grows thickest here; this is where I was born.

lines.zh: 我很少见，你得多走几片林子。
lines.en: I am rare; you must search a few groves.

lines.zh: 母熊猫把我放在竹根之间。
lines.en: My mother laid me among the bamboo roots.

lines.zh: 清晨的竹林很凉，我缩成一团。
lines.en: The dawn grove is cold; I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 我从竹丛后面慢慢挪出来。
lines.en: I shuffle out from behind a bamboo clump.

lines.zh: 刚出生的崽，连竹子都咬不动。
lines.en: Newborn cubs cannot even bite bamboo.

lines.zh: 这片林子安静，适合养大一只崽。
lines.en: This grove is quiet, good for raising a cub.

lines.zh: 你踩断竹枝的声音，把我吵醒了。
lines.en: Your snapping twig woke me from sleep.

lines.zh: 竹林深处传来一声喷嚏，那是我。
lines.en: A sneeze comes from deep in the grove; that is me.

lines.zh: 毛烧焦了，味道真难闻。
lines.en: My fur is singed, and the smell is awful.

lines.zh: 从竹子上滑下来，摔得屁股疼。
lines.en: I slide down the bamboo and land hard on my rear.

lines.zh: 水太深了，我划得很吃力。
lines.en: The water is deep, and I paddle with difficulty.

lines.zh: 爆炸的响声把我震得趴下。
lines.en: The blast knocks me flat on the ground.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进肩膀，火辣辣的。
lines.en: Something pierces my shoulder, hot and sharp.

lines.zh: 身上发冷，竹叶都在打转。
lines.en: A coldness spreads over me; the leaves spin.

lines.zh: 竹林被砍光了，我饿得发晕。
lines.en: The grove was cut; I am faint with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷声太近，我吓得趴在地上。
lines.en: The thunder is too close; I flatten myself down.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我一路往下沉。
lines.en: My footing vanishes, and I sink downward.
